title: C++: Template Engine (Simulated)
description: Build a simple template engine that replaces {{placeholders}} with values.

steps.title: Template Replacement
steps.description: Write a function string render(string tmpl, string key, string val) that finds {{key}} in the template and replaces it with val. Test: render('Hello, {{name}}!', 'name', 'World').
hints: Replace using substr and string concatenation.
